insight: We identified a cluster of organizations that exchanged funding, shared connections, received public funds, and showed extra risk signals around activity and concentration. Cluster #141 links deaf org 001, deaf org 002 in a 2-hop loop with $539,500 in circular flow and $89,257,445.15 in surrounding public-funding exposure. It scores 4/6 because entities are connected through shared directors; at least one organization is highly government-funded (max 80.3%). Organization labels are anonymized for public viewing. These are screening indicators for human review, not determinations of wrongdoing.
